trigger.condition: MappedIntelligenceAdapter.Start receives no Conductor and returns before graph construction.

likelyCauses.text: The mapped adapter start caller omitted its required Conductor.

diagnostics.action: Confirm this exact log and Conductor-presence flag at the mapped construction call; do not dump the conductor.
diagnostics.expected: The current source guard and redacted input metadata discriminate this exact message.

correction.boundary: Operator proposal for the owning caller/wiring only; no runtime or provider execution here.

steps.action: Restore the intended Conductor wiring at the owning caller after confirming its lifecycle; stop if ownership is unclear.
steps.expected: The edited local input satisfies the cited guard without changing unrelated policy or source.

stopWhen: The intended value or owner is unknown, the observed message differs, or source identity changed.

verification.action: Confirm the Start call passes a non-null Conductor and the line-26 guard is false.
verification.expected: The edited input no longer meets this cited failure guard; runtime success remains unverified.

entries.redaction: Exclude prompt/system/content text, media bytes/URLs, credential/header values, full Plan/Jacket and provider payload; retain only adapter/activity, exact error label and presence/type/count flags.
limitations: Source-only confidence; no provider or runtime execution was performed.
Other exceptions and upstream/downstream failures can still occur.
